name: Garments of Darkness
summary: In Brill, Dark Cleric Beryl tests fledgling Forsaken priests before they delve deeper into shadow. The trial shows whether they can heal and fortify an injured Deathguard, for the priesthood calls for more than afflicting enemies.

sections.title: A Balance of Dark and Light
sections.body: Forsaken priests draw renown and a distinct identity from shadow and darkness. Dark Cleric Beryl also teaches that understanding darkness means learning light and restoration. Those who seek only ruin are urged to study arcane magic instead. A priest's calling includes strengthening and preserving comrades as well as afflicting enemies.

sections.title: A Duty in the Graveyard
sections.body: North of Brill's cemetery, Deathguard Kel holds the line against prowling gnoll packs and has been wounded. Beryl sends you to bind his wounds with healing spells and bolster his stamina with protective enchantments. In this way, you show you can maintain Tirisfal Glades' defenders. Beryl grants you his vestment and accepts you into the priesthood's higher mysteries.

faq.q: Why do Forsaken priests use healing magic if their power comes from darkness?
faq.answer: Dark Cleric Beryl teaches that Forsaken priests draw exceptional strength from shadow, but healing remains essential. Before mastering darkness, an acolyte must learn supportive and restorative magic to keep Forsaken defenders standing on the battlefield.

Deathguard Kel is a Forsaken sentry stationed north of Brill's cemetery. He defends local settlements against aggressive gnoll packs wandering the woods and needs aid when wounded in the line of duty.
Dark Cleric Beryl, the priest trainer in Brill, offers it after you complete In Favor of Darkness.

faq.q: What vestments are granted upon finishing the trial?
faq.answer: Beryl awards a tailored robe as a badge of station and accomplishment. It marks the priest's mastery of fundamental duties and recognition by their peers.

faq.q: What threats was Deathguard Kel fighting?
faq.answer: Kel was wounded fighting local gnolls that infest the wilderness of Tirisfal Glades north of Brill's cemetery.

faq.q: What darker powers does Dark Cleric Beryl hint at?
faq.answer: Beryl hints at shadow techniques unique to the Forsaken priesthood, including distinctive manifestations of shadow magic and mental affliction not practiced by priests of other races.

angles.text: As a Forsaken priest, you balance shadow's grim utility with the duty to fortify and heal allies.
As Forsaken, you use healing magic to sustain front-line soldiers like Deathguard Kel against gnolls and Scourge remnants.
